name: items
title: DonationValues taxonomy (item specifications)
description: One row per item specification. dv_id values are stable forever: never reused or renamed. Retired specs keep their row with status=retired and superseded_by set.

fields.name: irs_group
fields.description: IRS 'similar items' group for the $5,000 aggregation test

fields.name: excluded_from_household
fields.description: True for jewelry, art, collections and similar categories that Pub 526 excludes from the household-items rule

fields.name: subcategory
fields.description: Project taxonomy level 2; the text before the colon in DeductIt's Browse convention

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: dv_id of the parent spec used for value inheritance when minimum sample rules are not met

fields.name: checklist
fields.description: Attributes a collector must record for this spec

fields.name: superseded_by
fields.description: dv_id that replaces a retired spec

fields.name: introduced_in
fields.description: Edition in which the spec first appeared, e.g. DV-2027
